subject: Clarify: embeddings pricing (vector unit vs token) and dimensions
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olive-analytics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@olive-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings pricing question: per-vector vs per-token and dims

Hi Markus,

Hope youre well. Quick question as we prepare an internal cost model for a pilot: how does Redwood count embeddings for hosted API billing? A couple of specific asks:

- Is pricing quoted per-vector (i.e., each embedding output counts as 1 regardless of dimensionality) or per-token consumed when creating the embedding from source text?
- If pricing is per-vector, how do dimensionality tiers (e.g., 128/512/1536/3072) factor into price — are there different prices per-dimension bucket or is it flat?
- If per-token, do you charge on the input tokens only, or both input + any internal tokenization overhead?
- Which embedding models are included in the hosted rate card (were evaluating text-embedding-3-small/large and some community models); are larger-dim models (3k+ dims) supported on hosted plans?

Were running a small POC (50k vectors over 2 months) and also looking at 6-12 month commit discounts. Can you share the latest hosted embeddings rate card and any packaging recommendations for low-to-mid volume customers?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of ML Ops, Olive Analytics
procurement@olive-analytics.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing question: per-vector vs per-token and dims

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list of questions. Short answers up front, then attachments and notes below.

- Baseline hosted billing: primarily per-vector for embeddings. Each embedding output is counted as one vector unit.
- Dimension tiers: we currently price by vector unit, with optional dimension premiums for high-dim models (>=2048 dims) on hosted plans. For the POC sizes you mentioned, the difference is typically a small multiplier rather than linear per-dimension billing.
- Token charging: when callers request embeddings via the embeddings endpoint, we do not separately charge input tokens for the embedding generation call — the hosted embeddings SKU is per-vector. (Note: generating embeddings inside a text-generation prompt would be billed differently.)
- Model support: hosted catalog includes our verified models (text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large) and a set of vetted community models. Models that require special hardware or exceed hosted memory profiles (very large dims, custom quantization) may be hosted as "specialty" SKUs or require Dedicated.

I attached our public hosted embeddings rate card and a short worksheet that shows illustrative math for 50k vectors at 1536 dims vs 3072 dims. See attached: redwood-embeddings-ratecard-2027.pdf (summary) and olive-pricing-worksheet-sample.xlsx (calc).

Notes on batching and counts: we count vectors produced, not API requests. If you send a batch of 100 texts and receive 100 embeddings, that counts as 100 vector units. Theres no hidden per-request fee.

If youd like, Neha can share commit/discount tiers and packaging that maps to your expected consumption. Laura — tagging you for commercial packaging options and standard lead times on enabling higher-dim hosted SKUs.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-embeddings-ratecard-2027.pdf, olive-pricing-worksheet-sample.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olive-analytics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@olive-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing question: per-vector vs per-token and dims

Markus — thanks, thats helpful. A couple of follow-ups after reviewing the worksheet:

1) When you say "dimension premiums" for >=2048 dims, can you give the exact multiplier or price bracket? For example, is 1536-dim the same unit price as 512-dim on the hosted plan?

2) Clarify the tokenization edge case: we plan to preprocess long documents (up to ~3k tokens) and chunk them before embedding. You mentioned you don't charge input tokens for the embeddings call — to confirm, we won't be billed for the tokenization you do client-side, correct?

3) Supported models: do you have a published list (or link) of which community models are currently allowed on hosted? We may test a vendor model that outputs 3072-dim vectors — is that something you host today or would that need Dedicated?

Also — were sensitive to pricing predictability. For a small pilot we want to avoid surprises, so would a small committed volume (50k vectors/mo for 3 months) get a firm price guarantee? If so, what does the discount look like?

Appreciate it,
Samir

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olive-analytics.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing question: per-vector vs per-token and dims

Hi Samir — Neha here (sales). Quick follow-up on discounting and packaging:

- Commit tiers: we offer standard commit discounts for Hosted embeddings: 10% at 100k vectors/month, 15% at 250k vectors/month, and custom pricing (20%+) for multi-year enterprise commitments. For your pilot (50k vectors/month) we can offer a small one-time pilot credit and a time-limited price lock for the pilot period to avoid surprises.
- Price guarantees: we can put a 3-month price lock on the pilot at a defined per-vector rate once the PO is signed.
- High-dim hosting: for a 3072-dim vendor model we usually evaluate memory and performance needs — in many cases we can enable it on hosted under a specialty SKU with a modest premium (~1.25x) versus the baseline vector unit price. If the model requires restricted runtimes we may recommend Dedicated.

If you can share the expected monthly vector volume by dim buckets (e.g., 40k @1536, 10k @3072) Ill run exact numbers and a short proposal. Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olive-analytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing question: per-vector vs per-token and dims

Quick billing clarification from finance:

- We bill by vector unit on the hosted embeddings SKU. A 1536-dim vector counts as 1 unit. Dimension premiums are applied as a multiplier on that unit.
- For batched requests we aggregate produced vectors per invoice period. Example: if you send 10 batched calls that produce 1,000 embeddings total, the invoice will show 1,000 vector units.
- There is a separate line item for "specialty model surcharge" when a hosted specialty SKU is used (e.g., 3072-dim vendor model). That surcharge is applied per-vector as a multiplier and is visible on the invoice.

Ill have a sample invoice and line-item descriptions attached to the quote Neha generates.

-Ben
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
